principle: Every operational CTA must answer the single most operationally correct next step right now.

invariants.name: no_duplicate_workflow_invitation
invariants.rule: If active issue/job/contractor/quote/inspection exists for lineage, suppress start/create CTAs.

invariants.name: continuation_when_active
invariants.rule: Active workflows must surface continuation CTAs with ownership context, not fresh-start verbs.

invariants.name: cross_surface_next_step_parity
invariants.rule: Risk/Issues/Jobs/CommandCentre/Contractor/Tenant must agree on operational phase for same object.

invariants.name: no_backend_rejection_after_encouraged_cta
invariants.rule: Encouraged UI/API CTAs must not 4xx when lineage already satisfies objective.

invariants.name: truthful_degraded_pressure
invariants.rule: Degraded orchestration must disclose degradation and preserve urgent continuation visibility.

invariants.name: no_orphan_operational_state
invariants.rule: Open issues/signals must expose owner path (linked job, assign, escalate, or explicit blocked reason).

invariants.name: no_dead_end_non_terminal
invariants.rule: Non-terminal jobs/issues must expose at least one meaningful next action or blocked-state explanation.
